# Brand theme (Bosch-inspired, ACKE.in)

Source of truth: `scripts/theme.py`. `validate_deck.py` fails on any run color outside this palette.

| Role | Name | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary | red | `ED0007` | accents, section labels, blocker bars, actual burndown line |
| Primary | blue | `005691` | titles, table headers, KPI numbers |
| Primary | navy | `003B6A` | title/closing background gradient start |
| Secondary | light_blue | `00A9E0` | subtitles on dark, committed bars |
| Secondary | teal | `18837E` | goal icon, color bar |
| Status | green | `3E9B2F` | ON TRACK, low severity |
| Status | amber | `FFC000` | AT RISK, medium severity (use dark text on it) |
| Neutral | dark | `263238` | body text |
| Neutral | gray | `EBEFF2` | cards, zebra rows, footer strip |
| Neutral | mid_gray | `8A9BA8` | ideal burndown line |
| Neutral | white | `FFFFFF` | text on dark/blue |

## Typography
Arial everywhere. Title 32pt bold (hero 48-54pt), body 18pt, table text 14pt, cards 12-14pt, footer 11pt.

## Layout
16:9 (13.333 x 7.5 in). Content margin 0.6 in. Segmented 5-color bar along the top of content slides (bottom of hero slides). Short red accent under each title. Footer strip from 7.0 in with the ACKE mark, deck/team/sprint/week text, and page number.

## Logo
Generated by `scripts/generate_assets.py`: a hexagon with a cut-out "A" and a red signal dot, plus the "ACKE.in" wordmark ("ACKE" in blue/white, ".in" in red/light blue).
- Title and closing slides: `acke-logo-white.png` on the dark background.
- Content slides: `acke-logo-mark.png` in the footer.
- Use SVG variants for web/docs. Do not recolor, stretch, or add effects.
